requirements: Run bash -n on solr/docker/tests/shared.sh, solr/docker/tests/cases/demo/test.sh, and solr/docker/tests/cases/demo-tini/test.sh at the exact head.

Exercise assert_demo_unavailable in an isolated shell with a stub Docker command: exit status 1 and matching diagnostic succeeds and removes the container; an always-running container times out, fails and is forcibly removed; wrong exit status, missing diagnostic, failed inspect and failed logs each fail. Stub sleep to avoid a real 60-second wait. Capture actual commands, stub behavior and results.
Run ./gradlew tidy and report tracked changes; changed files require a new committed head and gate.
Run ./gradlew check -x test and record the result.
Full and slim :solr:docker:testDocker require real Docker and remain pending separately in GitHub Actions. Do not call stub or non-Docker checks Docker proof.
